verdict.rationale: The evidence pack is dominated by marketing language ('ultimate', 'colossal', 'incredible performance') rather than a transparent spec sheet with clock speeds, TDP/power figures, memory speed support, or AI TOPS numbers tied to test conditions; only scattered non-performance specs like ECC support, NVMe RAID modes, and supported Linux OSes appear. No evidence shows AMD publishing base/boost clocks, wattage, or AI TOPS with disclosed test methodology for this SKU. Missing for 10: base/boost clock figures, TDP/power specs, memory speed/support table, AI TOPS figures with documented test conditions.
